text:
maria: morning — rumor mill: Competitor Z shipped a low-cost embedding tier overnight. customers are asking if we have a budget option.
raj: spotted small traffic churn on two pilot accounts last night. nothing catastrophic but trend is clear.
olivia: ran a quick head-to-head on 3 internal corpora. their embeddings are quantized, avg top-10 precision loss ~1.7% vs our standard. latency slightly better. notebook coming.
lee (data): i'll scale the eval to 20k queries and give a business-impact estimate (CTR proxy + recall loss cost). can do overnight.
taylor: need product framing: do we build EmbedBudget, price-match, or double-down on value (better analytics + eval visibility)? each has different infra and GTM costs.
ben: infra facts: to hit their price we likely need an 8-bit quant model + separate serving pool and slightly different batching. not trivial — spike + perf tuning needed. estimate 4-6 weeks to stable canary.
dina (sales): sales feedback: deals keep asking for predictable, low per-embed pricing. a simple per-request budget SKU would sell faster than complex feature flags.
maria: let's define crisp launch gates if we pursue a "budget" embedding: a) precision@10 gap <= 2.0% vs default, b) 95th latency <= 140ms for hosted, c) unit cost <= $0.0007 per 768-d, d) per-tenant auto-rollback on sustained quality loss. any additions?
olivia: add an adversarial shard in the holdout set to capture edge regressions. also require human-review queue during canary for odd buckets.
lee (data): add a drift detector and daily quality snapshot; surface retrieval_success and a CTR proxy.
raj: canary plan proposal: 1% traffic x48h -> 10% x48h -> 25% x72h. automated routing fallback if tenant-level retrieval_success drops >5% over 30m.
taylor: GTM guardrails: hosted-only launch, non-SLA tier, opt-out for enterprise/Dedicated until validated. marketing to emphasize cost-first use cases (cold index, nightly batch indexing).
ben: ops note: separate cache policy for small embeddings, and tokenization cost meter. will need 2 GPU canary nodes + an infra spike to build quant image.
dina (sales): i'll validate price elasticity with three trial accounts — what price points should i test?
maria: start with $0.00065, $0.00055, $0.00045 per 768-d for trial cohorts. collect feedback and churn signal.
olivia: owners & deadlines: - olivia + lee: bench + adversarial set by EOD Thu - raj + ben: infra spike + rough rollout timeline by next Tue - taylor: pricing + sales one-pager by Mon - dina: customer thresholds by Mon. sync Wed 10am for go/no-go.
raj: also recommend we instrument per-query quality labels so sales can show customers side-by-side comparisons.
maria: agree. if anyone finds competitor perf artifacts or open-source quant configs, drop them here. deploy-bot: canary VM request queued for approval (2 x gpus).
